name: Curtsy Lunge
research: Front = left leg, right foot steps back and across. Front leg: ankle stays (0.13,-0.01,0.074); shin 10 deg forward -> knee (0.13,-0.09,0.52); front knee 85-95 deg so thigh runs back-up 15 deg -> hip L (0.12,0.35,0.63); pelvis joint = hip centre + (0,0.051,-0.003) = (0,0.398,0.631). Back leg: hip R (-0.11,0.35,0.63) to ankle R (0.10,0.80,0.14) = 0.70 m (<0.90 leg) -> ~77 deg knee bend, IK puts the knee near (0.02,0.36,0.20): joint 0.20 m up, kneecap ~0.15 m off the floor ('nearly touches'). Back foot rot X +30 = heel up on the ball (ball ~0.02 m above floor). Crossed x +0.10 = curtsy. Trunk 6 deg forward, chest up. Arms hang (elev 10, palms in). Sources: Boren 2011 PMC3201064 (transverse lunge 49/48% MVIC glut max/med), Prehab Guys (weight on front leg, knee not caving), Muyor 2020 PMC7112217. Fix 12 Nov (review: the back leg did not visibly cross, read as a reverse lunge; dumbbell against the back knee; back toe 2 cm in the floor): back ankle now (0.30, 0.78, 0.165) = 17 cm PAST the front foot (x 0.13) toward his left, 0.79 m behind it; hip R to ankle 0.75 m -> knee ~(0.14, 0.36, 0.25), bent ~68 deg, knee pole (0.1,-0.6,0); the back thigh passes behind the front leg (thigh centres >= 0.18 m apart) and the back knee is now ~0.5 m from the right dumbbell. Camera yaw -160 / pitch 15 (behind his right side): the back leg runs from the right hip across behind the front foot, an X that reads as a curtsy, and the glutes (primary) face the camera. Facts and checks: research/curtsy_lunge.json. 13 Nov 2026 (pics-fixes): QA: the back leg read as stepping back to its own side. Back ankle now (0.36,0.60) = 23 cm PAST the front foot toward his left and 0.61 m behind it (was 0.79 m behind, so the cross looked small); camera from straight behind (yaw -172, pitch 14) so the legs make a clear X; 'ground' sets both feet on the floor from the real skin. 13 Nov 2026 fresh review (look A, 384 px), NOT yet applied because renders were paused for the new look: FAIL - camera from straight behind (yaw -172) hides the back leg crossing behind the front leg in the end, so it reads as a plain reverse lunge. Use a 3/4 rear view from the side the back leg crosses to (about yaw -140..-150, pitch 15).
